title: Large Language Models to Identify Social Determinants of Health in Electronic Health Records

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual demographic injection using GPT-4 to insert gender descriptors into synthetic clinical sentences, followed by measuring the discrepancy rate in Social Determinants of Health (SDoH) classification predictions between the original and modified sentences.

Counterfactual demographic injection using GPT-4 to insert race and ethnicity descriptors (e.g., Asian, Black, White, Hispanic) into synthetic clinical sentences, followed by measuring the discrepancy rate in Social Determinants of Health (SDoH) classification predictions between the original and modified sentences.
